description: This file defines a database migration for an e-commerce application, creating tables such as Baskets, CatalogBrands, CatalogTypes, Orders, BasketItems, Catalog, and OrderItems. It includes instructions for creating sequences, tables, indexes, and foreign key constraints to set up the initial database schema.

classes.name: InitialModel
classes.description: A migration class inheriting from Migration, representing the initial database schema setup with Up and Down methods.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to apply the migration, creating sequences, tables, foreign keys, and indexes.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines how to revert the migration, dropping the tables, sequences, and constraints.
